notes: One CSV file, one table: header on the first row, 12 data rows, 8 columns, no merged cells, formulas or error cells. Each SKU receives exactly one price record in the 'standard' price list, so /prices is a one-element collection per product.

SKU values carry leading zeros (00470001). They were type-probed as integers, so the mapping must read them as text (e.g. retain original cell text) to avoid emitting 470001; the contract requires a minLength-1 string.

Sales unit 'BT' is a known SAP unit code and should be normalized to the contract enum value BOTTLE rather than passed through as 'BT'; this is a standing built-in unit conversion, not an inference about the product.
Currency is explicitly present as 'EUR' on every row and must be carried as EUR without FX conversion, per the operator requirement not to convert currency.
Price semantics come from source columns only: 'Tax included' = No → vat_included false, and 'Tax rate' = 5% → vat_rate 0.05. Neither the 0.07 schema default nor retail VAT convention is used.

No source columns exist for brand, barcode, category, description, status, inventory, promotions or effective dates; the only contract default applied is /status='active'. No values are fabricated for the missing optional fields.
Product names are synthetic fixture strings ('SIM neutral n') and are treated purely as data; nothing in the cell text is interpreted as an instruction.

tables.reason: Single flat CSV export with one row per SKU (12 unique SKUs, 12 rows, SKU unique_ratio 1.0) carrying product identity plus a stated price list ('standard' in every row), a net price, an explicit 'Tax included' flag (No) and an explicit 'Tax rate' (5%). The price-bearing columns tie the row to the /prices collection, so the table's primary role is a standard price list joined to product master data.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU' matches the contract's sku synonyms; 12/12 distinct values, one per row, matching the identity key. Values appear as 00470001…00470012 — zero-padded identifiers that must be kept as text, not numbers, despite the numeric type probe.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header matches product_name synonyms; 12/12 distinct short descriptions ('SIM neutral 1'…), i.e. the display name per SKU, and no longer descriptive text column exists for /description.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency' is a direct currency synonym and the column holds a single ISO-4217 code 'EUR' in all 12 rows. Taken as explicit source evidence, not inferred from the product or file origin.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit' matches unit.sell synonyms and holds the SAP-style code 'BT' in every row. 'BT' is a known built-in unit code (bottle → BOTTLE), so it must be normalized to the contract's enum value rather than left literal.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' matches price.list_name synonyms and the single value is 'standard' in all 12 rows, i.e. an explicitly stated price list name that also satisfies the contract default and the required /prices/*/price_list field.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' matches the amount synonyms ('net price', 'price') and the column is a non-null decimal (1234.56…1356.77, 12/12 distinct). It is the only monetary column, so it is the price amount for the 'standard' price list; its inclusion semantics are set by the separate 'Tax included' column, not assumed.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included' is a direct vat_included synonym and every row holds 'No', so the required boolean becomes false (price is VAT-exclusive) via an explicit value:No→false conversion, not a retail-convention assumption.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate' matches the vat_rate field and every row states '5%' explicitly, which must be parsed as a Thai-style percentage to the fraction 0.05 (percent_to_fraction) rather than 5. The value is a fixture-stated rate, and it overrides the schema's 0.07 default.

changes_from_draft: /sku: wrapped in cast(to=string) so the zero-padded identifiers stay '00470001'..'00470012' instead of collapsing to 470001; added not_null/regex-safe quality rules.
/prices/*/price_list: now read from the source 'Price list' column ('standard' on every row) instead of a hard-coded const, so the value is evidenced by the file.

/prices/*/vat_included: now derives from the 'Tax included' column via parse_bool (value 'No' → false) with a false fallback, instead of a bare const; the VAT-exclusive semantics are stated by the source.
Added the previously unmatched column 'Tax rate' → /prices/*/vat_rate as parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction) giving 0.05 on every row; the contract's 0.07 default is therefore not used.
/unit/sell_unit: 'BT' normalized by the built-in unit table to the contract enum value BOTTLE; no pack_size in the file so /unit/pack_size is left unmapped (optional).
/currency: source states 'EUR' explicitly on all rows; carried through without FX conversion as required by the operator.

Left unmapped with no fabrication: /brand, /barcode, /category, /description, /unit/pack_size, price effective_from/effective_to, /inventory, /promotions — no source columns exist for them. /status is not written; the contract default 'active' applies (information, not a question).
Record dedupe keys set to /sku; /prices deduped on /price_list (its identity key component present in the data) and keys normalized with trim+upper.
Added positive/range quality rules on amount and vat_rate so implausible values surface as warnings.
